newsitem.title: MEXICO: Penoles boosts 1996 metal sales, output.
newsitem.headline: Penoles boosts 1996 metal sales, output.

text.p: Metal sales and output at Mexico's largest mining company Industrias Penoles increased in 1996 over 1995, except for in lead, the company said in its annual report obtained by Reuters on Monday.

Penoles is the world's largest silver producer, with 1996 sales up 3.8 percent for the year to 1.667 million kgs from 1.606 million kgs the previous year. Silver production also jumped 3.8 percent to 1.741 million kgs from 1.678 million kgs in 1995, the company said.
